note: A 16:9 video, so every graphic is horizontal. The script asks for the hook text, the name plate, the title card, two explainer texts, a key-word stack, the brand wipe and chapter card at the break, and one top text, so 9 graphics and the end card. Every other row is captions only.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: I'm kind of a people person.

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “I'm kind of a people person.” Already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on. Out at 00:03.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top band.

mg.title: Name plate
mg.cue: Name plate at 00:11, small, lower left: Dr. Katherine Roche / Senior Investigator, NIH/NINDS.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:11 for 4 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Senior Investigator, NIH/NINDS> under the name.

mg.title: Title card

text.main: A research hospital where no one pays

mg.cue: Title card, full frame, 3.5 s: “A research hospital where no one pays”.
mg.use: Full frame at 00:18 for 3.5 s. Land the music hit on it.

mg.title: Explainer 1

text.main: Glutamate receptors help brain cells pass signals

mg.cue: Explainer 1 text, top, with the AI voiceover: “Glutamate receptors help brain cells pass signals”.
mg.use: Put it over the explainer B-roll after “really the entire time.”, with the AI voiceover, for about 4 s.

mg.title: GRIN key words
mg.cue: Key words one at a time, top, as she says them: NMDA receptors · GRIN genes · GRIN2B · GRIN2A.
mg.use: Start on “NMDA receptors” (about 01:12) and let each word land as she says it. Top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: Break wipe
mg.cue: Brand colour wipe, then chapter card, full frame, 2.5 s: “The NIH study”.
mg.use: The wipe opens the break at 03:15, straight into the chapter card.

mg.title: Chapter card
mg.cue: chapter card, full frame, 2.5 s: “The NIH study”
mg.use: Full frame after the wipe for 2.5 s. The music changes here.

mg.title: Explainer 2

text.main: Cell lines: living cells grown from a patient's own sample

mg.cue: Explainer 2 text, top, with the AI voiceover: “Cell lines: living cells grown from a patient's own sample”.
mg.use: Put it over the explainer B-roll after “patient-derived cell lines.”, with the AI voiceover, for about 5 s.

mg.title: Research hospital
mg.cue: Top text on “It's a research hospital.” (about 04:58), 2.5 s: “It's a research hospital.”
mg.use: Put it on as she says “It's a research hospital.” and hold 2.5 s. Top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: Register Here · curegrin.akaraisin.com/ui/gricon27 · GRI con 2027 · July 22–24, 2027 · Denver, CO.
mg.src: endcards/index.json (22 Oct 2026): no CureGRIN logo file yet (Lauren's high-res logo is still owed), so the name is typed. The shared end card layout is from the brief.
mg.use: Stand-in for the shared CureGRIN end card. Use the shared card from the approved short if you have it (both logos horizontal, GR icon on white, July 2027 calendar); this one types the name until the logo file arrives. Put it after “GRIN families.” and hold it to the end.
